concept: Warm & Powerful. A dual-experience platform. The public marketing site is an editorial, dark-themed magazine spread (Iron & Bronze) designed to elevate Kendra Albritton to the top 1%. The admin portal is a functional, light-themed workspace (Sand & Stone) for legal and operational management.

headings.usage: H1, H2, large display text. Must use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) and tight leading (leading-none).

body.usage: Paragraphs, navigation, buttons. High legibility, geometric contrast to the serif headings.

headings.usage: Dashboard titles, metric numbers, card headers.

body.usage: Data tables, forms, labels. Excellent for dense data readability.

typography.rules: Never center body text. Use large serif headings with strong left alignment for the marketing site. Use uppercase wide-tracking labels (text-xs tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and section markers.

marketing_theme_dark.description: Used ONLY for the public marketing website.

admin_theme_light.description: Used ONLY for the admin dashboard.

marketing.texture: Subtle grain/noise overlay on the dark backgrounds to remove digital flatness.
marketing.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header. backdrop-blur-xl with border-b border-[#2A2624].
marketing.image_treatment: Black/Bronze gradient overlays. Never use flat black over images. Example: bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent.

admin.cards: Flat white background, 1px subtle border (#E5E0DA), no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-sm and -translate-y-[1px].
admin.forms: High contrast borders for inputs, clearly indicating focus states with ring-2 ring-[#C17D59].

marketing.hero: Asymmetrical. Huge serif heading on the left, high-contrast image on the right or background with strong gradient overlay.
marketing.bento_features: Mode A (Tetris Grid). grid-cols-12, wide gaps, asymmetrical span logic for Services/Programs.

admin.dashboard: Mode B (High Density). grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12. Metric cards top row, main charts/tables below. Sidebar navigation.

marketing.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon' of fitness mantras (e.g. STRENGTH • RESILIENCE • POWER).
marketing.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Dark background with bronze border, or solid Bronze for primary CTA.

admin.shadcn_ui: Use Table, Dialog, Form, Input, Select, Tabs, Card. Must customize radii to be sharp (rounded-sm) and match the admin color palette.
admin.contracts: PDF generation should trigger a download. Show visual status badges (Pending, Signed, Uploaded) for contracts/waivers.

marketing.scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling (use Lenis if possible, or CSS smooth scroll).
marketing.reveal: Staggered fade-up for typography using framer-motion.
marketing.hover: Images subtly scale up (scale-105) with long duration (duration-700).

admin.interactions: Clear hover states on table rows (bg-black/5).

image_urls.description: Woman holding black rope. Use for the main hero section with a strong dark/bronze gradient overlay.
Powerful portrait of female trainer in black top. Use for the 'About Kendra Albritton' section.
Woman in black sports bra working out. Use for Services or Transformation gallery.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG standards. The bronze accent (#C17D59) must only be used on black or white backgrounds to ensure legibility.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='client-table-row').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build two distinct layout systems: A dark-themed public layout (HTML/Tailwind + Framer Motion) and a light-themed admin layout (Shadcn + dense grids). 2. For the Admin Portal, implement mock client data, a contract/waiver mock PDF generator button, and payment logging forms. 3. DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter for headings. Ensure Cormorant Garamond is imported and applied to marketing headings.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center align the app container. Create depth through layered design elements. Never use generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. No generic gradients. Add data-testid to all interactive components. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds behind nav text. Use react-icons or lucide-react for iconography. DO NOT use placeholder image URLs; use the provided image URLs.
